Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who?
 Passionate and creative, you take ownership of your projects and stay updated with the latest industry trends Autonomous yet highly collaborative, you are open to people and ideas and enjoy varied tasks You possess a strong ambition to develop high-quality solutions You have good English skills
 This role is hybrid, requiring 5 days/MONTH in the office (Bucharest).
 🚀Then what?
 Senior Full Stack Developer with a strong background in C#, .Net, and React, with the following tasks:
Play a pivotal role in the design, development, and maintenance of our insurance applications (both back-end and front-end components)
Collaborate with Business System Analysts, Software Architects, and other developers to understand project requirements and objectives
Take over technical analysis for selected requirements
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using modern programming languages
Take care of the quality of developed solutions and components via proper testing (developer tests, functional tests)
Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring optimal performance and reliability (including 3rd level support for production issues)
Continuously research and stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices to enhance development processes
 Required technical skills:
Over 5 years of applicable knowledge, skills, and experience with C#, .Net, and React 
Experience in SQL
JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, JSON, Visual Studio, open API web services)
Good OOP and SOLID code knowledge
Awareness of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile Development
Willingness to learn and understand the world of insurance
Nice to have: Experience in one or more client libraries/frameworks (Angular, Vue) and knowledge of Azure DevOps Server / Microsoft
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
